title: caddyhttp: preserve unknown placeholders in static response headers
body:
Fixes #8013

## Summary
the respond directive expanded header field names and values with `repl.ReplaceAll`, which blanks any `{...}` the replacer does not recognize, so a JSON header value like `{"key":"value"}` was sent empty and `value-{unknown}-kept` came out `value--kept`

this switches both to `repl.ReplaceKnown`, matching the header handler fix in #4880 (same class as #4418) and the `respond` body expansion a few lines below, so unrecognized braces are left intact and real placeholders still expand

### Steps to reproduce
1. `go test ./modules/caddyhttp/ -run TestStaticResponseHeadersKeepUnknownPlaceholders -count=1`
2. Expected: header values with unknown `{...}` survive, real placeholders still expand
3. Actual (raw output on untouched master):
```
--- FAIL: TestStaticResponseHeadersKeepUnknownPlaceholders (0.00s)
    staticresp_test.go:88: X-Json header = "", want "{\"key\":\"value\"}" (unknown placeholders in header values must not be blanked)
    staticresp_test.go:91: X-Lit header = "value--kept", want "value-{not-a-real-placeholder}-kept"
FAIL
```

regression tests in `staticresp_test.go` pin both directions: unknown braces survive and a set placeholder still expands

## Assistance Disclosure
AI used: yes, for drafting test coverage and description formatting
